firmwares.name: Attaky Launcher
firmwares.description: Boot menu / controller for the Cyber Deck: partition manager, SD app installer, module check, WiFi and serial console.

firmwares.name: Attaky DJ Scratch
firmwares.description: Single-deck DJ scratch & playback app: WAV/MP3 from SD, polar turntable, pitch rail, gamepad hot cues. Installs over the Launcher.

firmwares.name: Attaky Ghost ESP
firmwares.description: Packet capture / demo firmware for the Cyber Deck. No image is published yet — flashing from here is disabled until this entry ships a download URL.
firmwares.notes: No upstream build has been released for the Ghost ESP image yet.
